# Trilogy Trading Tools

> Rentable trading software for small-cap momentum traders: a real-time gapper scanner, a trading journal, and a budgeting app, sold month to month in CAD. Pre-launch: plans are open on a launch list.

## Tools
- 3T Pro Scanner: $175 CAD/mo. Real-time small-cap gapper scanner: live gap %, volume and float, dual charts and audio alerts, premarket through power hour.
- Halal 3T Scanner: $200 CAD/mo. The 3T scanning engine on a Sharia-compliant, AAOIFI-screened universe.
- Trilogy Journal: $100 CAD/mo. Trading journal with fast trade logging, live win rate, profit factor and average R, and the 3D Edge Surface.
- Wealth Builder: $200 CAD/yr. Budgeting app built around the Trilogy Split, with a bill calendar, card interest tracker and savings goals.

## Bundles
- Trader Pack (3T Pro Scanner + Trilogy Journal): $225 CAD/mo
- Halal Trader Pack (Halal 3T Scanner + Trilogy Journal): $275 CAD/mo
- The Full Trilogy (both scanners + Journal + a year of Wealth Builder): $325 CAD/mo
- Pay the year upfront for 10% off any monthly tool or package. Cancel anytime.
